common.final_test_exclusion: No 2023-2025 station outcome may be used to alter any baseline parameter.

local_conventional.name: quota-normalized Huaxing conventional timing
local_conventional.transformation: Use field-derived event timing, but quota-normalize event depths onto the common <=45 mm operational envelope. The fixed 45-mm preplant event is owned by the formal COX, not by the baseline policy.
local_conventional.role: Primary local conventional comparator and W100 timing reference for Y_ref(w).

derivation.irrigation_efficiency: FAO indicative field application efficiency for drip irrigation is 90%.
derivation.trigger_deficit_mm: 0.90 * 45 mm = 40.5 mm net deficit, so a full-capacity 45-mm gross event replaces one threshold-sized net deficit.
derivation.effective_rain_fraction: Set to 1.0 to credit all causal DSSAT PRED without introducing an unvalidated empirical runoff/effective-rain coefficient.
derivation.refill_fraction: Set to 1.0 for full replacement of the observed deficit; hard event/budget constraints remain external.

derivation.trigger_rew: Cotton baseline depletion fraction p=0.65 implies onset-of-stress remaining available water fraction approximately 1-p=0.35 under the AWM REW=(SW-LL)/(DUL-LL) definition.
derivation.event_depth_mm: Use the common field-informed 45-mm maximum event depth.
derivation.fallback_layers: Before DSSAT root-length weights become positive, use the top 30 cm (REW layers ending at 5, 10, 20 and 30 cm), consistent with an initial shallow cotton root zone; once roots are present the rule is root-length weighted.

selection_policy.reason: Parameters are fixed from field geometry/operations or external agronomic references before station final-test evaluation. Validation years are used for sanity/robustness checks, not parameter optimization.
selection_policy.change_rule: Any change after observing 2023-2025 station outcomes requires a new baseline protocol and cannot replace v1 results.
